summary: Real-case regression of thermostability for engineered α-amylase variants.
assay_method: Experimental thermostability measurements on α-amylase variants in the Protein Engineering Tournament.
provenance: A 'real_case' α-amylase dataset from the Align Foundation tournament; one random split, stratified on the target.
when_to_use: Applied stability ranking within one enzyme family; the practical target when engineering more robust α-amylases.
caveats: Small, single-scaffold; one random split, stratified on the target (no similarity split). Standardized target (MAE in standardized units).

citations.authors: The Protein Engineering Tournament (Align to Innovate)
citations.title: Results of the Protein Engineering Tournament: An Open Science Benchmark for Protein Modeling and Design
